$comment: The kinds a listed name can have, and what each means for a session: an agent is AI or automation working for a human; a bot is a named program that is not an agent. 'row' is the line of the dashboard's Agent block an agent kind is counted in ('ai': AI in a real browser; 'automated': Automated browser). A 'generic' kind names a tool anyone can run, so a more specific name matched in the same User-Agent wins over it. Labels are interface text (English only).

ai-assistant.label: AI assistant fetching for a human

ai-coding-tool.label: AI coding tool fetching for a developer
